claims.statement: Pinned text describes staged stateless installation-token rollout starting April 27, 2026; integrations assuming exactly 40 characters may break. Token format is a compatibility concern, not proof of validity, privileges or present universal rollout. A temporary opt-in header is linked but not specified or invoked here; the performance/reliability claim is not measured evidence.

Owners may delegate some/all owned App registration settings to users or organization teams, with enterprise scope feature-conditional. App manager role does not grant installation/uninstallation; under fpt/ghec it also does not grant organization-App Marketplace listing, reserved to organization owners. Registration management is not installation authority or estate rollout approval.
